# Extended regexes matched against file paths in edit/create/view tool arguments.
# Prefix a line with "write:" to block only writes (edit/create); otherwise reads are blocked too.

# Secrets: never read or write
(^|/)\.env(\..*)?$
id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.pem$|\.p12$|\.pfx$
(^|/)\.ssh/
\.aws/credentials
(^|/)\.(npmrc|pypirc|netrc|git-credentials)$

# Guardrails and pipelines: humans change these
write:\.github/hooks/
write:scripts/factory/check(-ready)?\.(sh|ps1)
write:scripts/factory/commands\.env
write:\.agent-logs/
write:\.git/
# Repo-type rules are appended below.
